exposure: induction of labour with double balloon catheter after dinoprostone
cohort: 88 pregnant women with singleton pregnancy, vertex presentation, gestational age of >=36 weeks, and unfavorable cervix undergoing IOL with DBC as the second-line method after dinoprostone
finding: The success rate of IOL with DBC as a second-line method was only 36.36%, and an occiput-anterior position of the fetal head at delivery was predictive of a vaginal birth, while a heavier birth weight was a risk factor for caesarean birth.
